limits: Q8 text still fails after the oracle repair; same-input projection checks and one changed activation code do not establish full-model correctness.
FFmpeg 9.0.2 differs from the earlier environment, whose codec version was not captured; cross-host pixel changes are not a production repair.
Other six formats and extended 480p/9-frame cases were not rerun on this replacement host; retain historical results and their original wrapper provenance.
Shared host/cgroup/GPU and release-fast binaries prevent isolated release-performance claims; the 81-frame 480p default remains untested.

Physical GPU reruns hit hard recovery/device lost, including an unchanged upstream shared F32/BF16 test. This isolates the failure from FastFrames weights, without proving whether the remaining cause is driver, hardware or shared device implementation.
